```yaml
name: Publish Studio NPM Package

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/studio/**'
      - 'packages/mesh/**'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Build packages
        run: bun run build

      - name: Get current version
        id: get_version
        run: |
          echo "CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/studio/package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check if version already exists
        id: check_version
        run: |
          if npm view @decocms/studio@$CURRENT_VERSION > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "VERSION_EXISTS=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "VERSION_EXISTS=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Bump version if needed
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          cd packages/studio
          npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
          NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Publishing new version: $NEW_VERSION"

      - name: Update mesh dependency version
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          cd packages/studio
          npm install @decocms/mesh@latest --save
          npm install @decocms/mesh@latest --save-dev

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          cd packages/studio
          npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Release Tag
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { NEW_VERSION } = process.env;
            github.rest.git.createRef({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              ref: `refs/tags/studio-v${NEW_VERSION}`,
              sha: context.sha
            });
            github.rest.repos.createRelease({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              tag_name: `studio-v${NEW_VERSION}`,
              name: `Studio v${NEW_VERSION}`,
              body: `Automated release of Studio v${NEW_VERSION}`,
              draft: false,
              prerelease: false
            });

      - name: Push changes
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update studio version to ${NEW_VERSION}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin main
```
